title: Reproducibility package: unsafe-side decision errors in infrastructure robustness screening
description:
Code, configuration, derived tables, generated figures and provenance records for a study of analytical percolation thresholds used as infrastructure robustness screens. The package contains the finite-network estimator with exact endpoint evaluation, the finite degree-preserving control protocol, the cohort-split and locked-allowance evaluation, the constant-offset comparator, response-definition robustness records, control order- and swap-budget ladders, window and failure-process sensitivities, and the figure and table builders, together with a runbook, a data manifest and per-file hashes.

Raw third-party source archives (OpenStreetMap extracts, pandapower cases, EPANET/WNTR models, SciGRID and PyPSA-Eur layers, World Bank series) are not redistributed. Their retrieval locations, versions and use conditions are recorded in DATASETS_AND_LINKS.csv, and the derived, non-sensitive outputs needed to regenerate the reported tables and figures are included.

The package accompanies the manuscript "Unsafe-side decision errors in infrastructure robustness screening: finite-network controls and external city-holdout transfer" under revision at Reliability Engineering & System Safety. It supersedes the earlier R209 release; all versions share the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21102470.
